name: OpenAuto EM Live Bridge
description: Real-time electromagnetic & SI/PI simulation loop on save for KiCad PCB traces. Computes controlled impedance, S-parameters, HyperLynx (.hyp), and openEMS FDTD models.
description_full: OpenAuto EM Live Bridge connects KiCad PCB Editor directly to high-speed electromagnetic simulation and real-time WebGL visualization. Whenever a PCB trace is modified and saved, the plugin instantly recalculates Wheeler conformal impedance, S11/S21 frequency response, skin depth attenuation, and updates simulation bridge files.
